text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew! The dirt here was a bit tricky to
run on...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But it worked out somehow. I can only
call the
results spectacular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute managed an excellent

performance despite being unused to
the dirt at
Oi Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer. You're the
whole
reason I was able to do this today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You and your intensive training. If
weren't for all
that hard work...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd probably be out there on the dirt
still, flat as a
pancake.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? I knew there was no
way you
could've been wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels like all our hard work has paid
off. And
after she ran so well today...
choice_data_list: So I really was able to help, huh...
So I really was able to help, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can say without any hesitation that my
training
style fits Wonder Acute
perfectly. If the two of us
keep this up,
then who knows what the future
holds in
store.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! Bravo! Congratulations, Acute!

Congratulations, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I trust you understand now how vital it is
for the
lead to be in harmony with the
supporting cast.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Opera O, your words are truer than I
could've
ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O casts me a quick glance.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The time has come. I hereby relinquish
the
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alas, no matter how long the run—no
matter how
much we pray to the
contrary, the curtains must
eventually
close on every show.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Acute, I have passed on all I know to
your trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, you still have a lot of
growing to
do. In addition, there are
things I've failed to
communicate to my
satisfaction. Nevertheless...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I entrust my charge to you, my sweet,
sweet
Papagena.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
While there are some things that can
only be
learned from the Overlord, there
are yet other
things that the Overlord
can never teach.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But I am certain you and your trainer can
discover
all the answers you need
together.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I won't pretend like I understood
everything
you've just told me, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think Trainer and I have a bright future
ahead of
us. In fact, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: After all, Trainer is a good person.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I believe that's my cue. Fare thee
well.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
May you both find bliss and
contentment at the
end of your path!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shout my thanks after T.M. Opera O.
After all,
she taught me a very valuable
lesson about being
a trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! No need, my friend! But
if you
absolutely insist...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then I insist you come with news of victory in a senior G1 race on your lips!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Approach me without such and I shall
land a
mighty Overlord strike upon your
brow!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Off with you, now! And don't forget...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The prima donna you challenge is
without a doubt
counted amongst the
ranks of royalty!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Royalty?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The prima donna we're challenging?
Could she be
talking about...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I think it is! Wow, it's...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ☆ Thanks for coming to watch
the Japan
Dirt Derby today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've seen how many
incredible
Umamusume are running on
dirt, please show
everyone lots of love
from now on! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: It is her! It's Smart Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That was such a good race! Even that girl
who
always used to be so nervous ran
like a real pro.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was teensy bit worried about her
because I
thought she didn't have strong
enough footing...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Especially for the dirt here at Oi... but
she got
through it A-OK! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, lower body strength is super
important!
You need it when you step,
when you make a
turn, and especially...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When you go all-out right at the end!
But yeah, if
she can keep this up then, I
tell ya, she's gonna—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Smart Falcon? Who are you talking
about
exactly?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's the big question, isn't it? If you
really
wanna know, then...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You'll have to wait till the end of the
year! I'm
pretty sure she'll be ready by
then. ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I know that today's race
went well
and all, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do I really have what it takes to catch
Falco right
now? Be honest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute looks conflicted.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I was only up against other classic-year
runners,
that would be one thing. But
Falco...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her fears are not unfounded. It's just like
T.M.
Opera O said...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is, without a doubt, dirt
racing
royalty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have a lot of work to do if we want
to stand a
chance against her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll need another race under my belt if I
want to
close in on Falco. Got any ideas,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's a good question. There are some
dirt G1s
open to both classic- and
senior-year racers in
the early fall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That may be too much for her to handle
so soon,
though. We should probably
ease into things with
a G2... No, a G3...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Sirius Stakes is a G3 race held in
early
October. It may be open to
senior-year racers,
but it should be just
the challenge we're looking
for.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, it sounds like you thought of one
that's
just right for me. Thanks, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for that one, then. And now
that that's
settled, let's get back to
camp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrooooom...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We return to camp on an overnight bus.
Now that
we've got our sights set on the
Sirius Stakes, it's
time to jump back into
intensive training.
